mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where RSAFS shows a 3-month increase, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points in a single month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher costs.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances where INDPRO shows a 3-month decline, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% in a single month and real GDP (GDPC1) shows a quarterly increase, it signals a strong demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% in 1 month AND GDPC1 increases
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both trigger conditions are met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a single month and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4%, it signals inflationary pressure coupled with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month AND FEDFUNDS > 4%
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where both trigger conditions are met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs per month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where PAYEMS shows a 3-month increase, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 1% in a single month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) increases by more than 0.3 percentage points, it signals a weakening supply side coupled with a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases > 1% in 1 month AND UNRATE increases > 0.3pp
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where both trigger conditions are met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
